name: superdev
description: 18 skills + 54 agents for full-stack monorepo builds. v2.0.0 removes the conductor/orchestrator: the main agent builds directly with superdev-build (plan on disk, stack choice Nest.js/Laravel x Next.js/Inertia, contracts first, then one module at a time — backend, boot-the-dist runtime verify, frontend, browser verify), backed by standalone recipe and audit skills (design-to-nextjs, design-to-laravel, nestjs-enterprise-backend, laravel-enterprise-backend, laravel-bref-deploy, security-review-and-fix, exploratory-qa, systematic-debugging, product-completeness-audit, production-readiness-audit, brutal-exhaustive-audit, frontend-modular-architecture, frontend-refactoring, prototype-to-saas, design-preservation, superdev-self-learning, superdev-done), hard rules distilled from real build failures (dead-on-arrival dist under green tests, ESM contracts, patchNestJsSwagger boot crash, @Audit on the wrong handler, parallel contract races, dev-default secrets, Radix code on Base UI shadcn), and a cross-platform verify-done script that runs the checks live instead of reading a self-graded ledger. Workspace-scope and package-manager agnostic.

interface.shortDescription: Full-stack build, audit, QA, migration, and refactoring skills.
interface.longDescription: Superdev brings Codex a skill-first full-stack toolkit for PRD-to-product builds, design-to-Next.js conversion, NestJS backends, prototype migration, QA, security review, debugging, product-completeness audits, frontend modularization, and atomic refactoring. The bundled Claude subagent files are kept as reusable role prompts; Codex runs the workflows through skills and explicit delegation.
defaultPrompt: Use Superdev to audit this product before ship.
Use Superdev to productionize this prototype.
Use Superdev to build from my PRD and design.
